items.title: Malik Willis: Tosses two TDs in loss to Pats
items.text:
Willis completed 21 of 32 passes for 211 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England. He gained two rushing yards on his only carry.

items.title: DeMario Douglas: Hauls in long TD in win
items.text:
Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Racks up 90 scrimmage yards Sunday
items.text:
Stevenson carried the ball 19 times for 82 yards and caught all three of his targets for eight yards in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

items.title: Jeremy McNichols: Injured against Eagles
items.text:
McNichols headed back to the locker room in the second half of Sunday's game against the Eagles and was walking with a limp, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

items.title: Drake Maye: Produces three TDs in Miami
items.text:
Maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins. He added five rushing yards and a TD on eight carries.

items.title: Omarion Hampton: Nets just 27 scrimmage yards in loss
items.text:
Hampton rushed nine times for 20 yards and brought in two of three targets for seven yards in the Chargers' 24-9 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
